justification: The most specific visible correspondence is the use of long horizontal linear motifs subdivided by many short vertical strokes, accompanied by small human/animal figures. The biggest difference is that A is a dense carved relief on an upright stone with stacked registers and deeply textured forms, while B is a broad red outline drawing dominated by a large boat-like shape on a flat rock surface.
